assertions.statement: Only the gate, the observer and the enumerated control-plane clients connect to the apiserver port
Only the apiserver binds the apiserver port
Only the gate binds the I04 port
Only the server connects to the I04 port
Only the apiserver connects to the datastore socket
Only the kubelet connects to the container runtime socket
Only the broker connects to I05
Only the policy writer connects to I07
The gate is the sole reader of its two upstream credentials
Only the apiserver and controller-manager read the service-account signing key
Only its owner reads planeon_observer_cred_t
Only its owner reads planeon_server_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_apiserver_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_controller_manager_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_encryption_key_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_kubelet_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_netpol_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_proxy_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_scheduler_cred_t
No domain writes or relabels a sealed type in an enrolled boot (fs-verity is enabled in maintenance)
In the maintenance boot only the maintenance domain writes or relabels a sealed type
Before the seal only containment and the runtime (E1) load BPF programs
After the seal and in maintenance only the runtime (E1) loads BPF programs
Enrolled programs are map-free: no domain creates, reads or writes a BPF map
Before the seal containment (as loader) and the reader roles obtain containment program descriptors
After the seal only the reader roles obtain containment program descriptors
Only the runtime obtains descriptors of the runtime's own programs
Before the seal only containment (S4) and systemd (maintenance-boot entry) set booleans, each in one commit
After the seal no domain sets a boolean, loads policy or switches enforcing mode
In the maintenance boot only the maintenance domain changes booleans or loads policy
No domain ever switches SELinux to permissive
Only init enters containment, only before the seal
Nothing enters containment after the seal or in maintenance
Only the admin login enters maintenance, only in the maintenance boot
Nothing enters maintenance in an enrolled boot
Only init starts the resident daemon roles
Only the broker starts the worker (after no_new_privs, through nnp_transition)
No planeon role or the writer starts in the maintenance boot
Only the admin login enters the policy writer, through its entrypoint
No dynamic transition into any declared domain
No declared domain may setexec (checked on the caller itself)
No domain ptraces a declared domain
No declared domain may execmem, execstack or execheap
No domain has execmod on any declared type
No domain runs an entrypoint, the interpreter or container content without a transition
Only init, containment and the reader roles search or open planeon cgroup directories
Only init, containment and the reader roles open or read planeon cgroup files
Before the seal only init and containment write the slice, containment, server, observer and gate cgroups
After the seal only init writes the slice, containment, server, observer and gate cgroups
Only init, the broker and (before the seal) containment write the broker's delegated cgroups
After the seal only init and the broker write the broker's delegated cgroups
No domain relabels a planeon cgroup or a pin: their labels come from genfscon path rules
No declared domain except systemd holds CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
No declared domain holds CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH in a user namespace
Only systemd and the confined kubelet and runtime hold CAP_SYS_ADMIN
CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE only for systemd, the server and gate (enrolled only with a signed port below 1024), the admin login and the runtime
Only containment and the reader roles read bpffs pins (readers open them with BPF_F_RDONLY)
Only containment creates pins, only before the seal
Nothing creates pins after the seal or in maintenance

assertions.ref: W02a seal marker; W01 5.2 S5; review R10
assertions.statement: Only containment writes the seal marker, in the enrolled boot (S5, after S4)
Nothing writes the seal marker in the maintenance boot
Only the gate reads or writes its journal in an enrolled boot
Only the datastore touches its data in an enrolled boot
Only systemd starts, stops or reloads planeon and backend units in an enrolled boot
Only systemd signals the resident roles, the writer and containment
Only systemd and the broker kill the worker
No domain outside the union of the /proc peers reads any planeon domain's /proc entries (per-target pairs: A59.<target>)
Only the server binds its signed listener port
Only systemd writes the planeon_maintenance_mode boolean, only in the initial state of the boot
Only systemd and containment write planeon_containment_enabled, only in the initial state
Only containment writes secure_mode_policyload, only before the seal
After the seal and in the maintenance boot no domain, maintenance included, writes the three planeon boolean files
